purpose: SINGLE SOURCE for the primitive data plane's flexible shapes (owner directive 2026-07-01): per-registry embedding COLUMN manifests (N columns, per-column dimensions/method), table-shape policy per storage tier (normalized truth / denormalized search projections / long-format staging+embeddings), and affinity-boost path policies. Consumers import these values; never re-type a dimension, column name, or path id elsewhere (no-magic-values law).

staging.notes: lifecycle/foundry outputs; schema-flexible; lossless; the raw layer distillation law protects

denormalized_projections: search_card_wide (materialized; rebuilt from normalized truth; carries hot attributes as typed columns + long-tail attributes as JSONB)
operational.embeddings_table: object_embedding (LONG format: object_id, column_name, method, dimensions, vector) — one row per embedding column per primitive; matches the CLAUDE.md object_embedding row family

embedding_columns.notes: Per-registry manifest; a primitive may carry MULTIPLE embeddings, each over a different field with its own method + dimensions. Small dims for compact vocabularies (edges), larger for prose. Methods are pluggable; deterministic lexical-hash stays the keyless floor (local-first law).
embedding_columns.blocking: semantic bucket keys (LSH-style) are derived PER COLUMN; blocking may key on any column combination

affinity_boost_paths.notes: W8 path-policy plane: multiple scorer paths; receipts pick the default per context; all boost-only.

paths.signal: seed + decayed outcome fold at query time

affinity_boost_paths.agreement_check: when paths disagree beyond a rank-order threshold, record a path_divergence event to the meta-ledger (W8) instead of silently trusting one
